headline.text: L1 S1 drain tested *EM positive* — cleaning and vector swabbing completed, line back in production after 6:30 AM delay.

summary: One environmental monitoring positive at L1 Sollich 1 required morning cleaning delay; swabbing completed and line released. L3 ML1 metal detector belt flipped twice in one shift despite maintenance adjustments. L2 panning rejected foreign material successfully.

food_safety.title: EM positive drain near S1 marshmallow mixing
food_safety.summary: Environmental monitoring swab returned positive; production delayed S1 startup, cleaned drain and surrounding floor, collected before/after vector swabs, and released line at 11:36 AM.
food_safety.status: Resolved — cleaning completed, after-swabs collected, line running, no backup observed in kitchen drain by end of shift.

food_safety.title: ML1 metal detector belt flipped twice during shift
food_safety.summary: Belt suddenly shifted and flipped at 14:25 and again at 14:27 despite maintenance adjustments; both shift leaders witnessed second incident, which occurred within seconds.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance adjusted belt twice, but root cause of sudden tracking failures not identified by window close.

food_safety.title: Foreign material rejected at panning/sorting
food_safety.summary: Panning line detected and rejected foreign material; all FM removed from product stream.
food_safety.status: Resolved — all foreign material rejected, no product released with contamination.

food_safety.title: S3 metal detector container scraping material into bin
food_safety.summary: Metal detector container too tight, causing material to scrape off and fall into reject bin; line leader informed.
food_safety.status: Open — floor cleaned with scraper, but container clearance issue not resolved by window close.

quality.title: ML4 chocolate appearance out of spec at startup
quality.summary: Depositor 1 produced chocolate with bad appearance at 07:31; temper stable, all off-spec product scrapped at demolding, appearance recovered after adjustments.
quality.status: Resolved — mold temperature increased, all off-spec chocolate rejected, product appearance within spec by 07:42.

quality.title: ML1 film tears causing holes in bar corners
quality.summary: Bars coming through with holes in corners at 33% rate (3 out of 10); line stopped, maintenance adjusted cut and film position.
quality.status: Resolved — maintenance adjusted film, issue corrected, line running.

quality.title: Truffle Line missing Saturday hourly QiSoft checks
quality.summary: Production did not submit hourly coconut oil organoleptic checks during Saturday run as required.
quality.status: Open — gap identified, no checks recorded for Saturday production; process accountability unclear.

sanitation.title: Vacuum cleaner not being emptied after shifts
sanitation.summary: Vacuum cleaner found not cleaned after first shift and CIL; reminder issued to empty after each shift and CIL cleaning.
sanitation.status: Resolved — reminder issued to first and second shift teams.

opportunities.text: Consider adding TG wrapper motor orientation verification to post-cleaning checklist — based on TG5 motor installed incorrectly after cleaning, causing line-down and product blow-off issues until 12:48.

Review ML1 metal detector belt tracking procedure and maintenance frequency — belt flipped suddenly twice in one shift (14:25, 14:27) despite adjustments, with second failure witnessed occurring within seconds.
Implement accountability mechanism for Saturday production QiSoft checks on Truffle Line — based on missing hourly coconut oil organoleptic verifications during 2026-11-15 weekend run.
